bibliographic_record.title: What every computer scientist should know about floating-point arithmetic

verbatim_excerpt: ACM Computing Surveys 23(1):5-48, March 1991. 'This paper presents a tutorial on those aspects of floating-point that have a direct impact on designers of computer systems. It begins with background on floating-point representation and rounding error, continues with a discussion of the IEEE floating-point standard...'
